title: RegistryDocument
description: Schema for a document in the data registry. Each JSON file in data/registry/ represents one document to be ingested into Weaviate.

source.description: Source label, e.g. 'Participedia Case Studies', 'GovLab', 'Reboot Democracy'.

doc_date.description: Document date in ISO format, e.g. '2021-04-12' (optional).

content_type.description: Content classification. If omitted, the pipeline will auto-classify via LLM.

content.description: Full document text content (Markdown or plain text).

pdf_path.description: Relative path to the PDF file (only when format is 'pdf').

ingested_at.description: ISO timestamp of when this document was last ingested (set by the pipeline).

document_id.description: Stable UUID for this document (auto-generated by the pipeline if not provided).
